full_judgment: 15. The central issue before this Court is whether the voluntary winding-up of Mark Industries (Pvt) Ltd was executed in compliance with all statutory requirements under the Companies Act, 1994, and whether there exists sufficient ground to allow the petitioners' application for restoration of the company. A further issue arises as to whether the present application has been filed within the permissible period of limitation, or whether sufficient cause has been shown to justify condonation of any delay in filing the same.
